title: Welcome back
subtitle: Sign in securely to your HR environment.
visualTitle: HR that moves with your organisation.
visualBody: One dependable place for people, organisation and payroll — with access always contained within the right customer environment.
visualPointIdentity: Your account is personal and verified.
visualPointContext: Tenant and administration boundaries are always enforced.
visualPointPreference: Your language and theme travel with you.
testLoginAsHrAdmin: Sign in as Test HR Admin
testLoginFailed: Test sign-in failed. Check the local test configuration.
resetInstruction: Enter your email address. If an account exists, you will receive a secure recovery link.
resetSent: If this address exists, you will receive a recovery email.
resetSubtitle: Restore secure access to your account.
passwordMismatch: Enter two matching passwords of at least 12 characters.
recoverySessionMissing: This recovery link is invalid or has expired. Request a new link.
passwordUpdateFailed: The password could not be changed. Please try again.
passwordUpdated: Your password has been changed securely.
invalidCredentials: The email address or password is incorrect.
authFailed: Google sign-in was not completed. Please try again.
providerUnavailable: Google sign-in is not available yet.
invitationOnly: Liquid HR is accessible by invitation only.
inviteSubtitle: Link your verified account and then activate your access.
invitePasswordHelp: Leave this empty if you only use Google. A password must contain at least 12 characters.
inviteSuccess: Your access has been activated. You will be redirected.
inviteInvalid: This invitation is invalid or expired.
inviteExpired: This invitation has expired. Ask your administrator for a new invitation.
inviteEmailMismatch: You are signed in with a different email address from the invitation.
inviteAlreadyLinked: This employee is already linked to another account.
invitePasswordRejected: This password does not meet the security policy.
inviteConfiguration: Invitations have not been fully configured yet.
inviteUnknown: The invitation could not be activated. Please try again.
inviteSignInFirst: First sign in with the email address that received the invitation.
inviteGoogleHelp: Use Google when it is linked to the same verified email address.
inviteGoToLogin: Sign in with email and password
inviteDifferentAccount: Not the right account? Sign out and use the invited email address.
noAccessBody: Your account is signed in, but has not been linked to a customer environment yet.
noAccessHelp: Ask the HR administrator who invited you to check your access.
oauthConsentTitle: Allow ChatGPT to access your own Workforce data?
oauthConsentDescription: Review the requested access before continuing. You can deny this request.
oauthConsentVisualTitle: You control which data you share.
oauthConsentVisualBody: The TEST connection uses your existing LiquidHR account and applies the same employee permissions as LiquidHR.
oauthConsentVisualPointSelf: Only your own data is requested.
oauthConsentVisualPointReadOnly: The available tools can only read data.
oauthConsentDataTitle: Data the Workforce tools can read
oauthConsentDevelopmentPlans: Development plans: period, progress, status, and completion date.
oauthConsentDevelopmentGaps: Development gaps from your current role profile.
oauthConsentSelfOnly: LiquidHR resolves your employee context. The request cannot choose an employee, tenant, administration, or role.
oauthConsentReadOnly: This TEST connection has no write actions. ChatGPT cannot change data.
oauthConsentEmailScope: The email scope shares your account email with ChatGPT.
oauthConsentOfflineAccessScope: Offline access allows ChatGPT to refresh tokens until you revoke access.
oauthConsentInvalidRequest: This sign-in request is invalid, expired, or belongs to a different account.
oauthConsentUnsupportedClient: This request does not use the allowed ChatGPT OAuth redirect. Close this window.
oauthConsentUnsupportedScope: The request asks for scopes outside the limited TEST sign-in and cannot be approved.
oauthConsentEmployeeOnly: This TEST connection is available only to an Employee account with a current self employee context.
oauthConsentNoEmployeeContext: No own Employee context with current access was found. You can deny this request.
oauthConsentContextSelectionRequired: More than one valid own Employee context exists. Explicitly select a context in LiquidHR before allowing this connection.
oauthConsentContextUnavailable: Your own Employee context could not be checked safely. You can deny this request and try again later.
oauthDecisionErrorTitle: Start a new connection in ChatGPT
oauthDecisionErrorDescription: LiquidHR could not safely complete the return to ChatGPT. This request has not been reopened. Close this window and start a new connection from ChatGPT.
oauthConnectionsDescription: Review which applications have access to your account. You can revoke ChatGPT TEST access here.
oauthConnectionsVisualBody: This page shows OAuth applications authorized through your own LiquidHR account.
oauthConnectionsVisualPointScope: The grant list comes from your signed-in session.
oauthConnectionsVisualPointRevoke: Revocation invalidates ChatGPT sessions and refresh tokens.
oauthConnectionsVisualPointEmployee: Employee self-service stays limited to your own data.
oauthConnectionsLoadFailed: Authorized applications could not be loaded safely. Refresh the page and try again.
oauthConnectionsConfirmDescription: ChatGPT will no longer be able to read LiquidHR data. You must authorize the connection again before using it.
oauthConnectionsRevoked: ChatGPT access was revoked and removed from your authorization list.
oauthConnectionsRevokeFailed: Access could not be revoked. Refresh the page and try again.
